_doc: Reference of make (experiments/str2rts, python -m rttools.paper.str2rts run): for each application of config.json, "row" (the values of the table: tasks, edges, mesh, criterion, M2, k, T, D, n(v_last), edges between PEs, packets per hyperperiod, f_CPU, f_search, R_bound, the term that sets the clock and the Hz that the removal of each term takes from f_search; source XML and STR2RTS commit), "clusters" (PE of each cluster, cluster of each task, cost of each cluster), "settings" (f_CPU, f* of the bisection, minimum and attempts of the flow and of the flow without the handler charge, with w_NI = 0, with w_h = 0 and with the three removed), "checks" and "status". Entries row, clusters, settings, checks and status of build/metrics.json of the run of 2026-11-18 (12 min 19 s with JOBS=5).
